api_key.description: Stored as plaintext in the private local SQLite database. Omit/null to retain; empty string clears active and historical credential values. Clearing is not cryptographic disk erasure.

agent_version.description: Historical reports only. Omit for new runs: Harbor uses its default container installation and the actual CLI version is independently observed before inference. Nonempty values in new run requests are rejected.

controlToken.description: Ephemeral local control token delivered by the native Desktop bridge, not a model provider API key.

info.description: Loopback-only read-only results; authenticated Desktop control. Provider keys are write-only and intentionally stored as plaintext in the user's private SQLite database. One explicit task and no implicit paid reruns.
info.title: Router Forge local backend
